title: Heisenberg-Weyl Representations and Morita equivalence for crossed products of Noncommutative solenoids
summary: We study strong Morita equivalence for crossed products of noncommutative solenoids by cyclic groups. Using their description as twisted group $\mathrm C^*$-algebras, we construct automorphisms induced by the natural linear action of $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb Z[1/p])$ on $\mathbb Z[1/p]^2$, for every integer $p>1$. For odd primes, we use the Heisenberg--Weyl representation to construct compatible cyclic group actions on the equivalence bimodules relating solenoids with reciprocal parameters.
